title: Counterfactual Dilemmas & Bioethics Essay
goal: Evaluate past clinical and public-health accountability with si + pluperfect subjunctive and read a C1 bioethics essay.

items: I can evaluate past institutional accountability with *si* + *hubiera/hubiese* + past participle and *habría* + past participle.
I can link a past public-health failure to a present consequence using the simple conditional in the result clause.
I can follow a bioethics essay on informed consent, confidentiality, health equity and palliative care.
